top.line: Type a company and see its AI helpers' reach, their mandate and the gap: the X-ray built for Web Summit.

in-short.line: Reach, mandate and gap; four search agents; read sources only; 13 companies for 1.13 dollars; models measured.

what.line: Three cards: what AI helpers can reach, what they were asked to do, and the gap; our own SGit as the example.

how.line: Four search agents, a collector, a growing graph, claims as leads, the mandate as an example; live from 11 November.

cost.line: Thirteen companies on 7 November, 0.056 to 0.124 dollars each, about 1.13 in all.

models.line: Perplexity 45 of 50, Haiku 49 of 55, OpenAI 35 of 41, Gemini 16 of 23 and no real search.

limits.line: Live results unreviewed; evidence vaults not done; mandates are the team's judgement.

sources.line: The X-ray pages and the Web Summit site's repository, read on 20 November.
